findings.mechanism: JWT tokens are decoded without signature verification, allowing attackers to forge arbitrary claims (04-jwt-and-revocation).
findings.remediation: Replace jwt.decode with jwt.verify(token, SECRET, {algorithms:['HS256']}) and reject tokens that fail verification.
findings.arithmetic: No arithmetic needed; the flaw is deterministic—any attacker‑supplied token will be accepted as valid claims.

prediction.condition: any attacker‑supplied token (e.g., a forged JWT)
